issue.title: Add a maxLength rule for text columns

body: This is likely caused by SQLServer telling us that the field is double the length it actually is because SQLServer uses ucs2/utf16 internally. There might not be a way around this.
Can't we just divide the value by 2?

> Can't we just divide the value by 2?

We could. We'd have to make sure the columns where `NVARCHAR` / `NCHAR` and not the standard `VARCHAR`/`CHAR` columns as only types with the `N` prefix have the double length issue.

issue.title: Fixed SqlserverSchema return colum length double the actual size
